from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class SearchResultsOutputModel(BaseModel):
    search_results: list[dict] = Field(default=None, description="List of search results.")
    query_summary: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Response to customer.")
    model_config = Field(title="Config", default={"extra": "forbid"})

# Save the new attraction search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="scenic_attractions", value=attractions_search)

# Find the nearest attractions to the hotel results
nearest_results = search_nearest(hotels=hotel_results, attractions=attractions_search, groupBy="hotel")

# Save the nearest results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_results", value=nearest_results)
